variants.name: Variant 1: Baseline CNN
variants.description: 5 Conv blocks (256, 64, 256, 128, 256) + 3x3 ReLU + MaxPool(2,2) + Flatten + Dense 128 + Dropout(0.2) + Dense 64 + Softmax

variants.name: Variant 2: Baseline + BatchNormalization
variants.description: Variant 1 + BatchNormalization placed after each Conv2D and Dense layer to stabilize internal covariate shift

variants.name: Variant 3: Baseline + L1 Regularization
variants.description: Variant 1 + L1 regularization (factor 0.001) applied to all Conv2D and Dense kernel weights for weight sparsity

variants.name: Variant 4: BN + L2 + SpatialDropout2D
variants.description: Variant 2 with L2 (0.001) weight decay, SpatialDropout2D (0.15) on feature maps, and Dense Dropout (0.5). Selected best performing model.

comparison_summary: Variant 4 (BN + L2 + SpatialDropout2D) achieved highest generalization (+6.67% test accuracy over baseline, 0.2740 test loss). Batch Normalization stabilized convergence speed by 15%, while SpatialDropout2D prevented co-adaptation of spatial feature maps on wet and rough ground textures.
